newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai residents spend more on insurance.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai residents spend more on insurance.

text.p: Shanghai residents are spending more on insurance than other Chinese, with accumulated per capita insurance spending of 38.1 yuan, seven times the national average, the Shanghai Securities News said on Thursday.

The newspaper said Shanghai has six Chinese insurance firms with total premium income of 3.07 billion yuan in the first seven months of this year. There are also two foreign insurance firms with licences to do business.
In 1995, the eight had a combined premium income of 5.09 billion yuan, it said without elaborating.
